author: GamingBolt
description:
Just when you thought that CD Projekt RED was stuck on “oops, all Witcher” mode for its releases, Cyberpunk 2077 gets yet another new update. It's probably not all that surprising, given that Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 recently premiered on Netflix. However, if Update 2.4 proved anything, it's that the team really likes to add on to the game, making it even better nearly six years later.

Enough reminiscing, though. Here are the ten biggest things you need to know about Update 2.5, and why you should jump back into Cyberpunk 2077, starting with the most obvious new addition.
title: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 Is Massive - 10 NEW Features You Need To Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
BioWare is shutting down. A year ago, maybe two, especially after the dismal performance of Dragon Age: The Veilguard, it wouldn't have been all that surprising. If this was the first real move Electronic Arts made after immediately going private – which, among other layoffs, is what this really is – it still wouldn't be the world's biggest shocker. 

A studio that's been underwhelming for more than a decade is gone? Wow, who could have seen that coming?
title: BioWare Is Officially Dead - What The HELL Happened?

author: GamingBolt
description:
The GTA franchise has certainly been a major presence in modern gaming over the years. There’s something about being let loose in a world where the only rules that matter are the ones you set for yourself, after all. However, that’s only part of the allure since the worlds you get to cause mayhem in are equally important parts of such experiences.

It’s great, then, that the franchise has always managed to nail that part of its efforts to engage so well, often creating worlds too compelling to write off even in its earliest iterations. We’ve taken a trip down memory lane, analyzing the visuals each successive game brought to the table to see how GTA has come from humble beginnings to the visual behemoth that GTA 6 is bringing to the fray.
title: GTA 1 to GTA 6 - The Insane Graphical Evolution of Every Major GTA Game
